speaker: Alfred Kyungu
title: Using the Language of Peacemakers
summary: Elder Kyungu takes up President Oaks’s April 2026 invitation to forgo contention and use the language of peacemakers, and calls it a call to discipleship, not a simple suggestion. He sets fourteen wounding phrases, from “You are useless” to “I am tired of you,” beside twenty peaceful ones, from “Please” to “I don’t want this to divide us,” and compares giving up harsh words to the converted Lamanites burying their weapons. He asks members to fill their hearts with Christ’s doctrine, repent of harsh words, pray for peaceful communication, and speak words that uplift and bring people together.
